build_oar_embedding_module: build a python module using OAREmbedding to embed observation action reward inputs together
create_oar_embedding_instance: create an OAREmbedding instance with a torso network and number of actions
run_oar_embedding_forward: run the OAREmbedding forward pass to concatenate observation features action and reward tensors
review_oar_embedding_call: review the OAREmbedding call method to understand how it processes OAR inputs
refactor_oar_embedding_torso: refactor the OAREmbedding to use a different torso network for observation feature extraction
